Hey, I'm Lucas. I'm a Data Science and Computer Science student at the University of Missouri (Mizzou).

I like building software and data systems that solve practical problems, whether that means writing automated ETL pipelines for large public datasets, creating desktop tools and interactive dashboards, or designing relational databases.

### Technical Toolkit

- **Languages:** Python, R, SQL, C, C++, Java
- **Data Engineering & Databases:** MySQL, SQLite, Pandas, NumPy, BeautifulSoup, REST API Ingestion
- **Backend & APIs:** FastAPI, Uvicorn, Spotify API (Spotipy), OpenAI API, OAuth Flows
- **Analytics & Visualization:** ggplot2, Plotly, Matplotlib, Association / Lift Analysis
- **App Development & DevOps:** Streamlit, Tkinter (Desktop GUIs), Docker, Docker Compose, Git

### What I've Been Working On

A lot of my work focuses on taking messy, real-world data and turning it into something structured and usable:

- **Data Platforms & Pipelines:** Ingested and standardized 900k+ federal fatal crash records across five years using MySQL, FastAPI, and Docker; built multi-source scrapers and SQLite storage for restaurant analytics.
- **Applied Analytics:** Analyzed early-career tech job postings in R and Python to identify skill co-occurrence and industry tech stack trends using association metrics.
- **Interactive Tools:** Built desktop GUIs and web dashboards, from a Spotify filtering app for classroom safety to interactive visualizers for state government expenditure data.

Take a look at the **Projects** tab to see breakdowns and demos of each build, or check out my code on [GitHub](https://github.com/Lucas-Gates).
